memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic kidney disease stage 3a with obesity.
Patient reports occasional fatigue, mild ankle swelling after long shifts, and no dyspnea. Examination shows BP 138/86, BMI 32 kg/m2, mild pitting edema bilateral ankles, lungs clear. Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.2 L (95%), FEV1/FVC 0.88; change from prior not applicable. Asthma Control Test score 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct salbutamol metered-dose inhaler use. Smoking status: former smoker, quit 2020, pack-years 10.
